name: Microsoft for Startups Azure Credits
free_limit: Eligible privately held software startups can apply for Microsoft for Startups and unlock up to $150,000 in one-time Azure startup credits over progressive program stages; an initial credit allocation may be available after application.
watch_out: Application and business eligibility review required; startup must operate where Azure is supported and must not be Series C or later, a consultancy, agency or other excluded entity. Credits increase only with verified progress and Azure adoption. Microsoft documents show inconsistent starter-credit examples; do not assume a fixed initial award. Third-party marketplace and some model charges may not be covered; monitor paid Azure usage.
